8 bit.gadget: Extra Credits is the better gadget right now because it can fire two ammo at once. Cheat Cartridge is still good into tougher matchups.
8 bit.starpower: Boosted Booster most of the time. Plugged In is good into tougher long-range matchups such as Brock or Penny.
8 bit.gear: Health all of the time, then choose Damage, Speed, or Vision depending on the map.

alli.gear: Damage and Shield. Speed is less necessary now because movement-speed effects do not stack.

amber.gadget: Dancing Flames most of the time, especially into aggro or on maps with lots of walls. Fire Starters is better into long-range brawlers.
amber.gear: Reload plus Vision, Damage, or Shield. Avoid the Mythic gear.

angelo.gadget: Stinging Flight is the safer option most of the time. Master Fletcher is still strong in Knockout/Bounty, especially on maps like Belle's Rock.
angelo.tips: Can hold down autoaim to charge an auto aimed shot.

ash.gear: Speed and Damage most of the time. Health and Damage can also work.
ash.hypercharge: Rats overwhelm opponents and allow cycling through multiple supers, turning him into a wipe machine.

barley.gadget: Sticky Syrup Mixer when going in blind or into assassins. Herbal Tonic is strong in Hot Zone or when Barley is picked into another thrower.
barley.starpower: Extra Noxious most of the time. Medical Use can be used into other throwers.
barley.gear: Damage and Shield most of the time. Gadget Cooldown can replace Damage.

bea.gadget: Rattled Hive most of the time. Honey Molasses can be used to tank pressure such as a Gene pull.
bea.tips: Slow projectile speed mean bea is best at midrange rather than max range.

belle.gadget: Nest Egg most of the time. Reverse Polarity is mainly a niche option on maps such as Out in the Open.
belle.starpower: Positive Feedback most of the time. Grounded can be used into assassins such as Mortis.

berry.gadget: Friendship Is Great everywhere except Heist, where Healthy Additives is better.
berry.gear: Shield plus Damage or Gadget Cooldown.
berry.tips: Attack is impact + damage zone after. Damage zone doesn't stack. Weak vs tanks

bo.gadget: Super Totem most of the time. Tripwire has some use in aggressive modes such as Brawl Ball.
bo.hypercharge: Wide-area damage that guarantees kills and shreds Heist safes, with fast cycling via mines.

bonnie.gear: Super Charge plus Damage or Health.
bonnie.hypercharge: Insanely strong because she can land multiple stuns per hypercharge and kill even the tankiest brawlers.

brock.gadget: Rocket Fuel is the better overall gadget. Rocket Laces is much more useful into aggression now because it gives two knockbacks.
brock.gear: Shield plus Damage or Gadget Cooldown.
brock.tips: User super and then hypercharge for max dmg.

bull.gadget: T-Bone Missile is the better option most of the time, especially in Heist. Stomper is still solid.

buster.gear: Use Speed, Damage, and Shield depending on the map and matchup.

buzz.gadget: Reserve Buoy most of the time in competitive play. X-Ray-Shades is the bushy-map option.
buzz.starpower: Eyes Sharp is the safest default. Tougher Torpedo can reward strong Buzz players in specific matchups.
buzz.hypercharge: Becomes “Spider-Man,” zipping across the map with unlimited stuns to make game-changing plays.

byron.gadget: Booster Shots almost all of the time because the extra damage helps cycle supers faster.
byron.starpower: Malaise most of the time. Injection is the switch into pet brawlers such as Charlie or Tara.
byron.gear: Shield plus Gadget Cooldown or Damage.
byron.hypercharge: Extends his versatility by giving a bigger AoE super that charges fast and can be used aggressively.
byron.tips: Autoaiming super almost always works perfectly.

carl.gadget: Flying Hook in Bounty, Knockout, and some Heist maps for pressure. Heat Ejector is better in modes such as Brawl Ball.
carl.tips: Before supering, throw out one attack.

charlie.gadget: Spiders most of the time. Personal Space is better when enemies can pierce the spiders, and can also be useful when Charlie is the gem carrier.
charlie.gear: Gadget Cooldown is especially good into single-shot brawlers. Damage is also usable.

chester.gear: Damage is the main gear. Pair it with Speed or Vision depending on the map.

chuck.gadget: Rerouting most of the time. Ghost Train is better when the setup needs to pass through a wall.
chuck.starpower: Both star powers are good and viable.
chuck.gear: Damage and Shield. Health can be useful in Hot Zone.
chuck.tips: Putting post above safe lets you hit safe twice on the way back. Put two posts stacked, super to them, and use rerouting to push post deeper.

clancy.gadget: Both gadgets are good, but Snappy Shooting is better.
clancy.tips: Stage one sucks and requires getting out of asap.

colette.gadget: Na-ah! is the better option even after its nerf. Gotcha! still has some potential.
colette.starpower: Push It is the better competitive option. Mass Tax is still strong in Heist.
colette.gear: Gadget Cooldown is preferred because Damage gear interacts awkwardly with Colette's percentage-based main attack.

colt.gadget: Speedloader almost all of the time. Silver Bullet is only for drafts where opening the map is specifically required.
colt.gear: Shield plus Damage or Gadget Cooldown.

cordelius.gadget: Replanting is the best competitive option. Poison Mushroom is a niche alternative into close-range threats such as Edgar or Damian.

crow.gadget: Slowing Toxin is the better competitive option right now. Instapoison was indirectly weakened by Crow's shorter poison duration.
crow.gear: Shield plus Damage or Gadget Cooldown.

darryl.gadget: Tar Barrel most of the time. Recoiling Rotator in Heist.
darryl.tips: Tip of his super will knockback again.

doug.gadget: Extra Mustard most of the time. Double Sausage only when Doug is specifically being used to heal teammates.
doug.gear: Switch between Damage and Speed depending on the map.
doug.hypercharge: Enables cheesy combos by hypercharging allies like Janet or Gray for unstoppable setups in Knockout/Bounty.

draco.gear: Use Damage, Shield, or Gadget Cooldown depending on the situation.
draco.hypercharge: Hard to charge but nearly guarantees team wipe.
draco.tips: Pairs great with Kit, Byron when supering. Great for when pressure is needed (hot zone, etc.)

dynamike.gadget: Fidget Spinner is often preferred because of its short cooldown, extra speed, and chip. Satchel Charge is still strong but has a much longer cooldown.

edgar.gadget: Let's Fly most of the time. Hardcore has niche use into Kit or other crowd control.
edgar.starpower: Fisticuffs is preferred for chaining kills. Hard Landing is still usable.

el primo.starpower: El Fuego. Meteor Rush is usable but less preferred.
el primo.gear: Damage plus Super Charge or Health.
el primo.tips: Super can be chained into suplex for a lot of CC.

emz.gadget: Acid Spray is the stronger general option. Friendzoner is very strong when facing aggression.
emz.gear: Damage and Shield on closed maps. Use Speed on bushy maps.

eve.gear: Reload and Shield. Avoid the Mythic gear.

fang.gadget: Roundhouse Kick most of the time because it confirms kills. Corn-Fu is a competitive option in some Knockout situations.

finx.gadget: Back to the Finxture is the default. No Escape has niche use for breaking Kit-based compositions by forcing Kit to detach.
finx.gear: Health and Shield most of the time. Damage is also usable.

frank.tips: Can wallpeek surprisingly well due to triangular attack.

gale.starpower: Blustery Blow is preferred because a stun can guarantee kills with teammate follow-up. Freezing Snow is still usable.
gale.gear: Vision is especially strong because Gale is often played on bushy maps. Pair it with Damage or Shield.

gene.gadget: Vengeful Spirits most of the time. Lamp Blowout is the switch into assassins or some Gem Grab situations.
gene.starpower: Magic Puffs is the better option overall. Spirit Slap can be used when you need to carry more damage yourself.
gene.gear: Vision most of the time. Use Shield instead on very open maps such as Shooting Star.
gene.tips: Move backwards after hitting a pull for longer CC.

gray.starpower: Fake Injury in Knockout/Bounty. New Perspective in Gem Grab, Brawl Ball, and Hot Zone.
gray.tips: Can super backwards after hitting pull gadget to extend pull distance.

griff.gadget: Piggy Bank is the better option. Coin Shower is used when breaking open the map would help the enemy draft.
griff.hypercharge: Chaining supers through walls lets him counter tanks and pull off devastating wipes.
griff.tips: Midrange wallbreaker. Use on any map you need a wallbreak + midrange on

grom.gadget: Radio Check most of the time. The alternate gadget can be used on maps such as Center Stage.

gus.hypercharge: His hypercharge super melts any assassin/tank that approaches, easy to cycle thanks to accurate shots.
gus.tips: Super niche but can spawn 2 ghosts if you shoot quickly and hit at max range.

hank.gadget: Barricade most of the time. Water Balloons is very good into tanks.
hank.hypercharge: Cycles hypercharge quickly and loves the speed/damage buffs, suffocating opponents with torpedoes.

jacky.starpower: Counter Crush. Hardy Hard Hat is usable into long-range comps.

jae yong.tips: Really versatile in many team comps.

janet.gadget: Backstage Pass is the better default, especially when Janet is being used as a gem carrier. Drop the Bass is still usable on bushy maps.
janet.gear: Vision and Shield on bushy maps; adjust by map as needed.
janet.hypercharge: One of the best hypercharges in the game, buy it.

jessie.gadget: Spark Plug most of the time, even in Heist. Recoil Spring is a niche Heist option.

juju.gadget: Elementalist is the better competitive option.
juju.starpower: Guarded Gris-Gris most of the time. Numbing Needles is better into assassins.

kaze.gadget: Gracious Host is the better high-level option. Hensojutsu can get easy value against weaker opponents.
kaze.hypercharge: In ninja form, dashes through weakened enemies for instant kills and easy super cycles.

kenji.gadget: Hosomaki Healing is the better option most of the time. The dash gadget can be better on Shooting Star and some Bounty maps.
kenji.hypercharge: Still really good post nerfs, but no longer guaranteed team wipes.
kenji.tips: Can dash into wall and then use swipe to wall peak for more dmg/range

kit.hypercharge: Turns him into an assassin by letting him chain hypercharge supers for back-to-back kills.

leon.starpower: Smoke Trails is the better competitive option. Invisiheal has niche use in Knockout and some Hot Zone situations.
leon.gear: Shield plus Damage or Gadget Cooldown.

lily.hypercharge: Teleports enemies into the “shadow realm” where they’re helpless, and charges quickly for repeated kills.

lola.gadget: Freeze Frame is preferred. Stunt Double is still usable but less convincing.
lola.gear: Shield plus Reload or Vision depending on the map.

lou.gadget: Cryo Syrup is the better option for most players. Ice Block is often preferred in pro play.
lou.hypercharge: Instantly freezes enemies with no counterplay, then cycles into another super for cleanup.

lumi.tips: Positioning attacks for return is very important.

mandy.gadget: Cookie Crumbs because it helps cycle super faster.
mandy.gear: Health and Shield into other snipers. Damage is also usable.
mandy.hypercharge: Boosts her damage enough to one-shot shielded snipers and meta brawlers, great for clutch team wipes.
mandy.tips: Try moving a little bit after every attack instead of just standing still.

max.gadget: Phase Shifter about 95% of the time. Sneaky Sneakers can be competitively viable in Hot Zone with good timing.
max.starpower: Super Charged is the better option right now. Run N Gun is still usable.
max.gear: Health and Shield. Damage can replace one gear.
max.hypercharge: Gives her whole team speed plus ¾ of a super, enabling massive tempo swings in fights.

meeple.gadget: Both gadgets are competitively strong. Use the control-oriented option into control comps and Ragequit into aggression.
meeple.gear: Shield plus Gadget Cooldown. Damage can replace Gadget Cooldown when the gadgets are less important.
meeple.tips: Best matchups are vs midhp brawlers (~6k range). Always preserve ammo to win engagement due to slow reload. Use super offensively on enemy walls.

meg.gadget: Toolbox is seeing more competitive use, though both gadgets are strong.
meg.starpower: Heavy Metal is still the preferred competitive option, though both star powers are usable.

mico.gadget: Clipping Scream most of the time. Presto has some situational use.
mico.starpower: Record Smash in Heist. Monkey Business everywhere else.

mina.gadget: Windmill most of the time. Capo-What? is better into counters such as Kenji, Mortis, and other aggressive brawlers.
mina.gear: Damage and Shield. Health is also usable.
mina.tips: good in gem grab, brawl ball

moe.starpower: Skipping Stones most of the time. Speeding Ticket can be better when Moe is outranged and needs help charging super.

mortis.gadget: Combo Spinner is the safer default. Creature of the Night has some use in Bounty.
mortis.gear: Damage and Shield for a simple setup. Speed or Health can be mixed in for more aggressive play.
mortis.hypercharge: Can chain bat supers through multiple enemies without getting close, leading massive pushes.

mr p.hypercharge: Forces enemies to waste shots on hypercharged ports, shutting down single-shot brawlers like Piper or Jean.

nani.gadget: Return to Sender into other sharpshooters. Warp Blast is useful in Heist and some other modes.
nani.gear: Health and Shield. Damage is also usable.
nani.tips: Overshoot behind a little to more reliably hit 2 shots

nita.gadget: Faux Fur most of the time because the invulnerability is very strong. Bear Paws can be good into tanks.
nita.starpower: Bear With Me most of the time. Hyper Bear in Heist.

nori.gadget: First gadget. Its 3,000 heal on a 12-second cooldown is the main reason it is preferred.
nori.starpower: First star power. It is preferred mainly because it synergizes with the first gadget.

ollie.gadget: All Eyez on Me most of the time because it helps deal with aggressive counters. The alternate gadget still has some situational use.
ollie.starpower: Renegade most of the time. The alternate star power can be useful on a few maps such as Battle of the Rocks.
ollie.hypercharge: Hypercharge lets him wipe teams with huge damage output, though it takes over three supers to charge.
ollie.tips: After hypnotizing, if you have teammate nearby, walk in straight line to make enemy easy to hit. Can auto-aim to shorten super distance.

otis.gear: Shield plus Vision on bushy maps. Otherwise use Damage or Super Charge.

pam.starpower: Mama's Squeeze most of the time. Mama's Hug is better on very open maps.
pam.gear: Super Turret and Health most of the time. Vision can replace Health on bushy maps.

pearl.gear: Shield plus Health or Vision depending on the map.

penny.starpower: Heavy Coffers most of the time. Master Blaster is mainly for Mortis or similar threats, especially in Brawl Ball.
penny.gear: Health or Vision most of the time. Damage is also usable.

piper.gear: Health and Shield into snipers and other long-range matchups.
piper.hypercharge: Adds damage and terrain opening to her jump, enabling aggressive plays and two-taps.

poco.gadget: Tuning Fork most of the time. Protective Tunes is a strong ranked counter to effects from brawlers such as Crow, Lou, Byron, or Willow.

r t.gadget: Out of Line almost always. Hacks! only on very long-range maps such as Shooting Star or Out in the Open.
r t.starpower: Recording most of the time. Switch star power on very long-range maps.

rico.gadget: Multiball Launcher most of the time. Bouncy Castle has some situational use.
rico.hypercharge: Unlimited bounce hypercharge cycles supers on the right maps, making him toxic and unstoppable.

rosa.gadget: Unfriendly Bushes most of the time. Grow Light is often the competitive reason to pick Rosa when the enemy has no wall break.
rosa.starpower: Thorny Gloves is the better general option. Plant Life is good when you need extra sustain.

ruffs.gadget: Take Cover into single-shot brawlers. Air Support when the sandbags would not get value.
ruffs.starpower: Air Superiority for wall break and in Knockout/Bounty. The other star power remains situational.

sandy.tips: Try to use super in a way that enables you to charge your super back. (Generally avoid using unless you have full hp and can push up with team).

shade.tips:
Heavily enabled by walls. Great in brawl ball, gem grab, and hot zone.
Matchup list according to spen: https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/931255199627112458/1314104641247514624/The_Only_Shade_Guide_Youll_Ever_Need_4-11_screenshot.png?ex=67528ed1&is=67513d51&hm=50f1dee469c3079dcde589f9abda83b33c46a33bfd4f2dceffb288ba4fa597f4&

shelly.gear: Use Speed, Damage, or Shield depending on the map.

spike.gadget: Life Plant most of the time. Popping Pincushion can be used into aggressive brawlers.
spike.starpower: Curveball. Fertilize is still less preferred despite its recent buff.

squeak.gadget: Windup in Knockout/Bounty. Residue everywhere else or when hard-countering a specific brawler.
squeak.gear: Shield plus Health or Gadget Cooldown.

stu.gadget: Breakthrough most of the time for aggressive play. Speed Zone is very good in Hot Zone and Gem Grab.

surge.gadget: Power Shield is the better option right now even with its longer cooldown.
surge.gear: Damage and Shield. Speed is usable on bushy maps.

tara.gadget: Support From Beyond unless the enemy team has lots of piercing attacks.
tara.hypercharge: Charges in only two supers, nearly unmissable, breaks terrain, and makes her dominant in Gem Grab.

trunk.gear: Damage and Shield. Speed is less necessary because his ants already provide movement speed.
trunk.hypercharge: Should be strong once bug is fixed, letting him instantly delete enemies when dashing through.

ziggy.gadget: Electric Shuffle most of the time. The alternate gadget has niche use into Edgar or Mortis.
ziggy.tips: His super is why he is good, so don't waste it and try to save ammo so you can cycle supers.

pierce.gadget: Bottomless Mags most of the time, even with its longer cooldown. Bubble Trouble is useful into aggressive brawlers such as Edgar or Mortis.

glowy.gadget: Spectral Surge is preferred because healing yourself and both teammates can generate about 75% of a super.
glowy.tips: Best in any control map, especially on more open maps. Reconnect beam to burst an extra 300 dmg. Glowy is all about good positioning.

sirius.tips: Try to keep your shadows alive and sync pushes with team. Will dominate control modes

najia.gadget: Poison Puddles most of the time. Use the second gadget into aggressive brawlers.
najia.starpower: Venomous most of the time. The other star power can be better into single-shot brawlers.

damian.gadget: Spiritual Healing is recommended most of the time because it helps Damian reach his first super. Wall of Sad is strong on certain Knockout maps and when the closing gas can be exploited.

starr nova.gadget: Floaty Time is the default because it enables aggressive plays and defensive escapes from brawlers such as Edgar or Mortis.
starr nova.gear: Damage and Shield. Speed is also usable because Starr Nova lacks range.

bolt.starpower: Unstoppaball is slightly better competitively if timed well. Toss-Up is easier and can be better in casual play.
bolt.gadget: Oil Change is the better competitive option. Bouncy Ball still has uses, especially when its wall break matters.
bolt.gear: Shield and Damage. Health is also usable.

wendy.gadget: Both very good. Wind-powered good default
